sources.games: 317 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 50.5%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py phantom_lancer.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Bloodthorn, Butterfly, Black King Bar.

rules.name: Bloodthorn

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: {item} silences them, and your attacks and illusions never miss the silenced target
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: {item} накладає тишу, і по цілі під тишею ваші атаки й ілюзії не промахуються

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Bloodthorn: Soul Rend silences for 5 s and gives True Strike to your attacks and your controlled units' attacks against the silenced target, so his illusions stop missing too; its passive pierces evasion on 40% of attacks. It is in his build (~35 min, Orchid at ~30): buy it earlier. Orchid 65% of 23 games against them (44% otherwise), won 67% against 25%.

rules.name: Butterfly
rules.basis: Butterfly: 35% evasion, so about a third of the enemy illusions' attacks miss; high-rank Phantom Lancers: 57% of 28 games against them (25% otherwise), won 75% against 33%.

reason.en: {enemy} fights with illusions: with the 35% evasion of {item} about a third of their attacks miss you
reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: з 35 % ухилення від {item} приблизно третина їхніх атак по вас промахується

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: wraith_band 34% (2), magic_wand 82% (3), power_treads 100% (6), yasha 99% (11), manta 97% (15), ultimate_scepter 89% (21), oblivion_staff 58% (29), butterfly 35% (29), skadi 66% (29), orchid 57% (30), aghanims_shard 50% (32), bloodthorn 42% (35), heart 34% (36).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where he wins 85.0%+: 25:00 16000 (30 games, 86.7%), 30:00 21000 (22 games, 95.5%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 317 games: maxed phantom_lancer_spirit_lance > phantom_lancer_phantom_edge > phantom_lancer_doppelwalk 241 (win 55.2%), phantom_lancer_phantom_edge > phantom_lancer_spirit_lance > phantom_lancer_doppelwalk 34 (win 32.4%), phantom_lancer_spirit_lance > phantom_lancer_doppelwalk > phantom_lancer_phantom_edge 18 (win 38.9%); talents 10: Juxtapose Illusion Trigger Chance 284/316 (50.4%), Spirit Lance Slow Duration 32/316 (53.1%); 15: Illusion Spirit Lance Damage 219/297 (49.8%), Doppelganger Cast Range 78/297 (65.4%); 20: Juxtapose Illusion Damage Taken 139/214 (59.0%), Spirit Lance Damage 75/214 (66.7%); 25: Doppelganger Cooldown 92/95 (65.2%), Illusory Armaments Duration 3/95 (33.3%).

suppress.break: Only his own attack out of Shadow Walk breaks (Valve 7.41f), his illusions do not, and 5700 gold comes off his Manta-Aghanim's-Skadi core; high-rank Phantom Lancers never bought Silver Edge against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar.
